title: 第17章 你妹妹在我这第18章 祸水东引
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“隆维克的城墙比第戎矮。”
“你心里比我更清楚，隆维克城挡不住哥布林大军的。”
“本来隆维克城的得失与我枫叶领并无关系，但本着唇亡齿寒的原则，考虑到隆维克若失，灰鸦堡便是它们下一个目标。”
“我们愿意出兵协助琉璃川公国从哥布林手中夺回第戎城。”
这话叶海确实没乱说，根据难民们带回来的消息，哥布林就是从北到南一路冲过来的。
要是按照这个势头下去，接下来就是隆维克城，然后就是灰鸦堡。
虽然从现在的情况来看对方好像是直奔琉璃川公国的首都第戎去的，但谁也没法保证对方会不会一路无脑冲下来。
哥布林可没那脑子区分灰鸦堡是不是琉璃川公国的地盘，他们只能区分出你是不是人类。
琉璃川千代听到这里眼眸不由得一颤，难不成叶海真打算帮助她们夺回第戎城？
不，不对，他一定还有别的心思。
琉璃川千代下意识咬住粉润的唇瓣，虽然她和叶海接触的时间很短，但也能看出来叶海绝对不是那种喜欢无私奉献的人。
但他究竟是图谋什么呢……
琉璃川千代眼中闪过一丝茫然，一时之间她还真没想明白。
叶海继续开口道：“如若同意，我枫叶领的军队将在一个月之内开拔，助琉璃川公国夺回第戎城。”
“哦，对了，还有件小事。”
“当枫叶领的军队前往第戎城的时候，可能需要借助隆维克城中转一下。”
“不过你放心，军队不会入城，唯有辎重运输队可能需要在此地略作补给。”
“当然，你要是不放心也可以拒绝我。”
“但你也要想清楚，今天你若拒绝，明天我只能守在自家城内遥望你们琉璃川公国的城池化作哥布林的巢穴。”
“以上，便是全部。”
“最后，你妹妹在我这里过得很好，无需担心。”
听到最后一句，琉璃川千代的脸色一僵。
到底哪里很好了！
都成女仆了！
她握着羽毛笔的手僵了许久。
直到叶海开口：“写啊，咋了，我又没虐待你，你说是吧。”
琉璃川千代抬起美眸颇为幽怨的盯着叶海看了一会儿，最终还是如他所愿把这行字写了上去。
叶海见此满意的点了点头，然后走过去把信纸塞进印着枫叶领标记的信封里，最后用刻着枫叶家族族徽的印章给信件封上火漆。
“哥哥，你明明就虐待了，千代姐姐今天从进城堡到现在可都还没吃过东西呢。”
蒂芙尼在一旁抱怨道。
“是这样吗？”
叶海愣了下，自从成为骑士之后，他一直处于一顿能吃半只羊，但是吃完之后一个星期都不饿的状态。
所以现在的他压根就没有饭点这个概念了。
他抬头看了看窗外黑色的夜空，转头看向琉璃川千代：“要不要让女仆给你送一份餐上来。”
虽然说她自己就是女仆，但叶海表示身为贴身女仆，允许她有一些优待。
“不用，我不饿。”
琉璃川千代摇了摇头，她也是修炼过呼吸法并觉醒生命种子的正式骑士，倒也没有那么娇弱。
也就是今天三餐都没吃而已，饿不死。
content_en:
: "The walls of Longvic are shorter than those of Dijon."
"You know better than I do that Longwick City cannot stop the goblin army."
"Originally, the gains and losses of Longwick City have nothing to do with our Maple Leaf Territory, but based on the principle of losing one's words and losing one's teeth, considering the loss of Longwick City, Gray Crow Castle will be their next target."
"We are willing to send troops to assist the Liulicuan Principality in retaking Dijon City from the goblins."
Ye Hai was indeed telling what he said. According to the news brought back by the refugees, the goblins rushed over from north to south.
If this momentum continues, Longwick City will be next, and then Gray Crow Castle.
Although judging from the current situation, the other party seems to be heading straight for Dijon, the capital of the Liulicuan Principality, no one can guarantee whether the other party will rush down all the way without thinking.
Goblins don't have the brains to distinguish whether Gray Crow Castle is the territory of Liulicuan Principality. They can only distinguish whether you are human or not.
Liulichuan Chiyo's eyes couldn't help but tremble when she heard this. Could it be that Ye Haizhen really planned to help them take back Dijon City?
No, that's not right, he must have other thoughts.
Liulicawa Chiyo subconsciously bit her pink lips. Although she had only been in contact with Ye Hai for a short time, she could tell that Ye Hai was definitely not the kind of person who liked selfless dedication.
But what exactly is he planning...
A trace of confusion flashed in Liulicawa Chiyo's eyes, and she really didn't think about it for a moment.
Ye Hai continued: "If you agree, the army led by Maple Leaf will set off within a month to help the Liulicuan Principality retake Dijon City."
"Oh, by the way, there's one more little thing."
"When the Maple Leaf Army goes to Dijon City, it may need to use Longwick City for transit."
"But don't worry, the army will not enter the city. Only the baggage transport team may need to make some supplies here."
"Of course, you can refuse me if you are worried."
"But you also have to think clearly. If you refuse today, tomorrow I can only stay in my own city and watch your Liulicuan Principality's city turn into a goblin's lair."
"That's all."
"Finally, your sister is doing well with me, there is no need to worry."
Hearing the last sentence, Rurigawa Chiyo's face froze.
What the hell is so good!
They have all become maids!
Her hand holding the quill was stiff for a long time.
Until Ye Hai said: "Write, what's wrong, I didn't abuse you, you think so."
Liulichuan Chiyo raised her beautiful eyes and stared at Ye Hai with resentment for a while, and finally wrote this line as he wished.
Seeing this, Ye Hai nodded with satisfaction, then walked over and stuffed the letter paper into the envelope with the Maple Leaf collar mark, and finally sealed the letter with a seal engraved with the Maple Leaf family emblem.
"Brother, you have obviously abused me. Sister Chiyo hasn't eaten anything since she entered the castle today."
Tiffany complained from the side.
"Is that so?"
Ye Hai was stunned for a moment. Since becoming a knight, he has been in a state where he can eat half a sheep at a meal, but he is not hungry for a week after eating.
So now he has no concept of meal at all.
He looked up at the black night sky outside the window, then turned to look at Rurigawa Chiyo: "Would you like the maid to bring you a meal?"
Although she said she was a maid, Ye Hai said that as a personal maid, she was allowed some preferential treatment.
"No, I'm not hungry."
Rurigawa Chiyo shook her head. She was also a formal knight who had practiced breathing techniques and awakened the seeds of life, so she was not that delicate.
That is to say, I haven’t eaten three meals today. I am starving to death.
